parameters.query:
SELECT p.*,
  s.avg_price_30d, s.min_price_30d, s.samples_30d,
  c.code AS coupon_code, c.discount_value AS coupon_value, c.discount_type AS coupon_type
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN v_product_price_stats s ON s.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM coupons c
  WHERE c.active AND (c.product_id = p.id OR c.category = p.category)
    AND (c.expires_at IS NULL OR c.expires_at > NOW())
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
) c ON TRUE
WHERE p.active
  AND p.opportunity_score >= COALESCE(($env.OPPORTUNITY_SCORE_THRESHOLD)::numeric, 70)
  AND (p.ai_classified_at IS NULL OR p.ai_publishable IS NULL)
ORDER BY p.opportunity_score DESC
LIMIT 30;

parameters.query:
UPDATE products SET
  category = COALESCE($1, category),
  subcategory = COALESCE($2, subcategory),
  target_age_min = $3,
  target_age_max = $4,
  audience = $5,
  ai_quality = $6,
  ai_publishable = $7,
  ai_content_angle = $8,
  ai_reason = $9,
  ai_classified_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $10;
UPDATE products SET ai_publishable = FALSE, ai_reason = $1, ai_classified_at = NOW() WHERE id = $2;
